def compress(grid):
    """The grid without its frontiers: every row and every column that is one color throughout."""
    rows = {i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1}
    cols = {j for j in range(len(grid[0])) if len({row[j] for row in grid}) == 1}
    return [[v for j, v in enumerate(row) if j not in cols] for i, row in enumerate(grid) if i not in rows]

def upscale(grid, factor):
    """Each cell as a factor x factor block of its color."""
    return [[v for v in row for _ in range(factor)] for row in grid for _ in range(factor)]

def crop(grid, top, left, height, width):
    """The height x width subgrid whose top-left cell is (top, left)."""
    return [row[left:left + width] for row in grid[top:top + height]]

def trim(grid):
    """The grid without its outermost rows and columns."""
    return [row[1:-1] for row in grid[1:-1]]

def replace(grid, old, new):
    """The grid with every cell of color old recolored new."""
    return [[new if v == old else v for v in row] for row in grid]

def hperiod(grid):
    """The smallest p such that every row repeats itself every p cells: the grid's width if none is smaller."""
    w = len(grid[0])
    return next(p for p in range(1, w + 1) if all(row[j] == row[j - p] for row in grid for j in range(p, w)))

def transform(g):
    H=len(g); W=len(g[0])
    # separator color = color of full rows
    sep=next(g[r][0] for r in range(H) if len(set(g[r]))==1)
    rseps=[r for r in range(H) if len(set(g[r]))==1]
    cseps=[c for c in range(W) if len({g[r][c] for r in range(H)})==1]
    rb=[r for r in range(H) if r not in rseps and (r==0 or r-1 in rseps)]
    cb=[c for c in range(W) if c not in cseps and (c==0 or c-1 in cseps)]
    bh=rb[1]-rb[0]-1 if len(rb)>1 else len(rb[0] and [x for x in range(H) if x not in rseps][:1])  # cell height
    # cell height = length of a row-block span
    spans=[]
    for i,r0 in enumerate(rb):
        r1 = rseps[[s for s in rseps if s>r0][0]] if any(s>r0 for s in rseps) else H
        spans.append((r0,r1))
    cw=cb[1]-cb[0]-1 if len(cb)>1 else W-cb[0]
    # template: cell with shape color that appears in only one cell
    from collections import Counter
    cells={}
    colors=Counter()
    for (r0,r1) in spans:
        for j,c0 in enumerate(cb):
            blk=[row[c0:c0+cw] for row in g[r0:r1]]
            nz={v for row in blk for v in row if v not in (0,sep)}
            cells[(r0,j)]=(blk,nz)
            for v in nz: colors[v]+=1
    tcol=[c for c,n in colors.items() if n==1][0]
    tcell=[v for (r0,j),(blk,nz) in cells.items() if tcol in nz][0]
    out=[]
    for (r0,r1) in spans:
        rowcol=[v for (r0b,j) in [(r0,0)] for v in cells[(r0,0)][1]]
        rowcolor=list(cells[(r0,0)][1])[0]
        for (r in range(r0,r1)):
            row=[]
            for j,c0 in enumerate(cb):
                for c in range(c0,c0+cw):
                    if c in cseps: row.append(sep)
                    else: row.append(rowcolor if tcell[r-r0][c-c0]==tcol else 0)
            out.append(row)
    return out

def transform(g):
    H=len(g); W=len(g[0])
    sep=next(g[r][0] for r in range(H) if len(set(g[r]))==1)
    rseps=[r for r in range(H) if len(set(g[r]))==1]
    cseps=[c for c in range(W) if len({g[r][c] for r in range(H)})==1]
    cb=[c for c in range(W) if c not in cseps and (c==0 or c-1 in cseps)]
    rb=[r for r in range(H) if r not in rseps and (r==0 or r-1 in rseps)]
    spans=[(r0,min([s for s in rseps if s>r0]+[H])) for r0 in rb]
    cw=cb[1]-cb[0]-1 if len(cb)>1 else W-cb[0]
    cells={}
    for (r0,r1) in spans:
        for j,c0 in enumerate(cb):
            cells[(r0,j)]=[[row[c0+c] for c in range(cw)] for row in g[r0:r1]]
    rowcolor={r0:list({v for row in cells[(r0,0)] for v in row if v!=0})[0] for r0,_ in spans}
    tcell=next(blk for (r0,j),blk in cells.items() if any(v for row in blk for v in row if v!=0 and v!=rowcolor[r0]))
    tcol=next(v for row in tcell for v in row if v!=0)
    out=[]
    for r in range(H):
        if r in rseps: out.append([sep]*W); continue
        r0=max(x for x in rb if x<=r)
        rc=rowcolor[r0]
        out.append([sep if c in cseps else (rc if tcell[r-r0][c-max(x for x in cb if x<=c)]==tcol else 0) for c in range(W)])
    return out

    """Every cell replaced by `pattern` (nonzero cells colored `color`, a color or a function of the block's top row); separator rows/columns kept."""
    rb, cb, rspan, cspan = blocks(grid)
    sep = separator_color(grid)
    rseps = set(solid_rows(grid))
    cseps = set(solid_cols(grid))
    H, W = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = []
    for r in range(H):
        if r in rseps:
            out.append([sep] * W)
            continue
        r0 = max(x for x in rb if x <= r)
        row = []
        for c in range(W):
            if c in cseps:
                row.append(sep)
            else:
                c0 = max(x for x in cb if x <= c)
                col = color(r0) if callable(color) else color
                row.append(col if pattern[r - r0][c - c0] != 0 else 0)
        out.append(row)
    return out
'''
